section_flow.notes: Transparent->blurred-on-scroll header with theme toggle (moon/sun), an animated call-now chip (shimmer sweep + ring + 'Call Now' label above the phone number), and an emerald BOOK NOW pill CTA. Hamburger drawer with full-screen translucent overlay.

Background photo with 75-90% dark overlay + three blurred green/teal glow orbs absolutely-positioned. Primary 'Get Protected' shimmer-sweep pill above the headline. H1: 'Smart. Safe.' white + 'Pest Control.' in emerald gradient-text. Rotating subline word cycles through pest names. Below: AI Pest Identifier + Call buttons, 5-star rating chip, and three checkmark trust badges (No Contracts / Same-Day / Pet & Family Safe).
Continuous-loop 35s linear marquee of pest names (Mosquitoes / Ticks / Ants / Rodents / Termites / Roaches / Spiders), each with a small emerald dot bullet.
Residential / Commercial / Mosquito-and-Tick cards with rounded-2xl glass surface, icon-in-tinted-square, title, paragraph, and animated arrow-arrow CTA link.
1000+ served / 5.0 rating / 10+ years counters on radial-glow background, with a giant '100% Satisfaction Guaranteed' shimmer chip below.
Essential / Premium / Ultimate plans with monthly pricing, bullet-check feature list, primary CTA. Middle plan is highlighted.
Nassau & Suffolk service area visualization with chips for each town.
Touch-friendly draggable comparison of Squito's multi-zone perimeter vs competitor foundation-only — 16:10 aspect.
Modal launched from hero CTA: upload an image OR click sample presets (Deer Tick, Asian Tiger Mosquito, Subterranean Termite, Cellar Spider) -> show risk assessment + confidence score.
Multi-step wizard with real-time price calc, add-ons (Mosquito & Tick, Termite Monitoring), and a promo code validator (GOSQUITO).

hero_signature: Dark photo background dimmed via two stacked rgba overlays. Three blurred glow orbs in green/teal sit absolutely behind the content (auto-hidden on mobile). The CTA appears ABOVE the H1 — a shimmer-swept emerald pill. H1 stacks 'Smart. Safe.' (white with crisp text-shadow) + 'Pest Control.' (green gradient-text). The subline rotates the pest noun dynamically. A rating chip with five filled amber stars + green checkmark trust badges complete the proof scaffold.
notable_features: Dual-theme support: dark (showroom black) AND light (cream/sand) controlled by data-theme attribute + CSS HSL variables
Theme toggle in nav with moon/sun icon swap (mobile version too)
AI Pest Identifier simulator modal (file upload + preset samples + confidence scores)
Multi-step booking wizard with live price calculation + promo code engine
Animated infinite marquee of pest names + reviews
Shimmer sweep animation on CTAs (translateX gradient over 700ms)
Count-up stat counters fed by IntersectionObserver
Rotating word in hero subline (pest name cycles every few seconds)
SVG fractalNoise grain overlay (3.5% opacity, overlay blend mode)
motion_vocabulary: ticker-scroll keyframe (35s linear infinite) for marquee
shimmer translateX keyframe sweeping inner light bar on hover
Glass card hover: border-color shift + translateY(-4px)
Theme transition (300ms cubic-bezier on background-color / border / color / fill)
Pulse animation on accent ring around logo
Mobile drawer slides in via translate-x
tailwind_extras_inline_css: HSL custom-property color system with darkMode 'class' + data-theme switching (full dark vs warm cream-sand light palette). .glass-card with HSL card + border + variable card-shadow (heavier in light mode). .glow-orb (absolute, blur 140px, mobile-hidden). .gradient-text (3-stop linear-clip-text). .text-body / .text-muted / .text-subtle / .text-ghost tier with per-theme alpha. .bg-tint-5 through 25 token system. Custom scrollbar (emerald in dark, neutral in light). SVG noise overlay with theme-aware filter:invert.
